items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: A fellow who is in California now by the name of Pearson.

ctx.x: Yeah. Mm-hmm. Who did, do you remember who saw Sam Gartman in this place?
A fellow who is in California now by the name of Pearson.
Oh, yeah. Did you hear your Fouche play?
